name: Bloom Of The White Crystal
source:
Sel has had nowhere to go for his entire life. So when he has no choice but to move back to his hometown - Ibori Peak, he's a bit reluctant.

Maybe he'll be able to start a new life though! Only problem is.. Ibori Peak is a town inhabited by bunnies.. And Sel just so happens to be a wolf. But what's the worst that could happen?

[From [url=https://cranberry-shortcake.itch.io/bloom-of-the-white-crystal]Itch.io[/url]]
